# Callout styling - animated water wave

/*
author: Azael
source: https://discord.com/channels/686053708261228577/744933215063638183/1179509194110546020
*/

@keyframes wave {
  0% {
    background-position-x: 20%, 50%, 20%;
  }

  25% {
    background-position-x: 0%, 70%, 0%;
  }

  50% {
    background-position-x: 20%, 90%, 10%;
  }

  75% {
    background-position-x: 0%, 70%, 30%;
  }

  100% {
    background-position-x: 20%, 50%, 0%;
  }
}
